title: DSH Upstream
subtitle: Configure and manage DSH external runtimes (upstreams). They follow the active Profile and persist across sessions.

section.listDesc: Configured DSH upstreams are registered as managed runtimes in the runtime-registry and show their connection status in the status bar.

list.empty: No DSH upstreams yet. Click "Add Upstream" to get started.

form.desc: A DSH upstream can be an HTTP(S) OpenAI-compatible endpoint or a local executable launched as a subprocess.
form.idHint: Unique identifier, e.g. local-dsh. Letters, digits and hyphens only
form.endpointHint: For HTTP(S) enter the endpoint URL; for a local binary enter the full executable path
form.cliArgsTemplateHint: One argument per line. Supports {prompt} and {cwd} placeholders. Required for local binaries
form.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the existing key; it will not overwrite the saved value
form.binaryNeedsTemplate: A local binary upstream requires a CLI args template
